artifacts.summary: Design spike resolving Decision D1: option (c) verified in Lean. Mathlib's Ultrafilter is Set-based (target type corrected to Order.PrimeFilter LindenbaumAlg); Order.PFilter.IsPrime alone is the ultrafilter predicate on a Boolean algebra (IsProper is derivable); all seven bespoke fields derive; dual transport of IsProper/IsMaximal/IsPrime is clean; the 1,071-line consumer ports by substitution; generic layer (202 lines) + project port (160 lines) + the PrimeSeparator TODO compiled sorry-free and reverted. Recommends FormalSystem/ForMathlib/Order/PFilter.lean with three surfaced decisions (location, bundled name, whether to define IsMaximal).
